description:
We bridge education, storytelling & tech! Our crew: an educator, a primary student & a coding-savvy high schooler.

Focus: Interactive space game or storytelling using NASA open data for young explorers.

Looking for: • Visual Designer (illustrations/assets) • Web or Game Developer (front-end/prototype) • Video Editor (2-min pitch video)

Join us for a creative, fun & impactful hackathon!
